name: Lykos Metals Limited
summary: Lykos Metals Limited acquires and explores mineral properties in Bosnia and Herzegovina, evaluating deposits of metals such as nickel, copper, cobalt, gold and silver, plus barite. It aims to secure full ownership of major projects including Sinjakovo (about 81 square kilometers), Cajnice (49.5 square kilometers) and Sockovac in Republika Srpska.
